f3_program: collection("angela.kitchen_supplies", "kitchen_supply", "angela", source("Angela's kitchen supplies"))
observe(at("angela.kitchen_supplies.pots.count", "current"), 20, "count", source("20 pots"))
member("angela.kitchen_supplies", "angela.kitchen_supplies.pots", source("20 pots"))
offset("angela.kitchen_supplies.plates.count", scale("angela.kitchen_supplies.pots.count", 3), 6, "count", source("6 more than three times as many plates as the pots"))
member("angela.kitchen_supplies", "angela.kitchen_supplies.plates", source("6 more than three times as many plates as the pots"))
fraction_of("angela.kitchen_supplies.cutlery.count", "angela.kitchen_supplies.plates.count", 1, 2, source("half as many cutlery as the plates"))
member("angela.kitchen_supplies", "angela.kitchen_supplies.cutlery", source("half as many cutlery as the plates"))
collection("sharon.kitchen_supplies_to_buy", "kitchen_supply", "sharon", source("kitchen supplies Sharon wants to buy"))
fraction_of("sharon.kitchen_supplies_to_buy.pots.count", "angela.kitchen_supplies.pots.count", 1, 2, source("half as many pots as Angela"))
member("sharon.kitchen_supplies_to_buy", "sharon.kitchen_supplies_to_buy.pots", source("half as many pots as Angela"))
offset("sharon.kitchen_supplies_to_buy.plates.count", scale("angela.kitchen_supplies.plates.count", 3), -20, "count", source("20 less than three times as many plates as Angela"))
member("sharon.kitchen_supplies_to_buy", "sharon.kitchen_supplies_to_buy.plates", source("20 less than three times as many plates as Angela"))
multiple("sharon.kitchen_supplies_to_buy.cutlery.count", "angela.kitchen_supplies.cutlery.count", 2, source("twice as much cutlery as Angela"))
member("sharon.kitchen_supplies_to_buy", "sharon.kitchen_supplies_to_buy.cutlery", source("twice as much cutlery as Angela"))
query("sum", "sharon.kitchen_supplies_to_buy", "planned")
collection("oil.cans", "can", "unspecified", source("24 cans"))
observe(at("oil.total_volume", "current"), 290, "liter", source("290 liters of oil"))
observe(at("oil.cans.count", "current"), 24, "count", source("24 cans"))
partition("oil.cans", at("oil.total_volume", "current"), source("290 liters of oil in 24 cans"))
observe(at("oil.cans.eight_liter_group.count", "current"), 10, "count", source("10 of the cans"))
observe(at("oil.cans.eight_liter_group.volume_per_can", "current"), 8, "liter", source("8 liters each"))

product_relation(at("oil.cans.eight_liter_group.total_volume", "current"), at("oil.cans.eight_liter_group.count", "current"), at("oil.cans.eight_liter_group.volume_per_can", "current"), source("10 of the cans are holding 8 liters each"))
difference_relation(at("oil.cans.remaining.count", "current"), at("oil.cans.count", "current"), at("oil.cans.eight_liter_group.count", "current"), source("remaining cans"))
difference_relation(at("oil.cans.remaining.total_volume", "current"), at("oil.total_volume", "current"), at("oil.cans.eight_liter_group.total_volume", "current"), source("remaining cans"))

quotient_relation(at("oil.cans.remaining.volume_per_can", "current"), at("oil.cans.remaining.total_volume", "current"), at("oil.cans.remaining.count", "current"), source("how much oil is each of the remaining cans holding"))
query("value", at("oil.cans.remaining.volume_per_can", "current"))
